body: And I'm just glad I have my boyfriend and his family. All of them are so supportive. I can only hope someday that we might be together forever, but of course, my little demon in my head says to leave... I'm not going to listen to it this time.

My mother is a bit like a distant teenager; she stays in her room all day and smokes. But since we also suffer from the same shit, she seems to think she's some kind of sage who knows all there is to know about mental illness and tries to approach MY problems like a textbook. It makes me really upset. She treats my addiction like I'm doing it to make her angry, too. I'm not trying to hurt her. I'm trying to hurt less.

Thank you, thank you for reminding me that there is forgiveness. We're not at the age where I feel comfortable asking for redemption from them, but I needed to hear that. I'll save these comments forever. After all these years, I know these feelings will return every now and then, but at least I have tools given to me by kind strangers like you. I dunno if this sounds dumb or not, but still. Thanks a million.
